         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">

        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
        <version>2.7.18</version>
        <relativePath/>
    </parent>

    <artifactId>userservice</artifactId>

    <name>User Service</name>
    <description>Legacy User Management Microservice</description>

**Key Details:**
- Spring Boot 2.7.18 (legacy version)
- Java 1.8
- H2 in-memory database
- Spring Security with JWT support
- Spring Data JPA
- JUnit testing framework

### 4. CONFIGURATION FILES

#### A. Main Application Properties (/workspace/src/main/resources/application.properties)

```properties
# Application Configuration
spring.application.name=userservice
server.port=8080

# Database Configuration (H2 In-Memory)
spring.datasource.url=jdbc:h2:mem:userdb;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1;DB_CLOSE_ON_EXIT=FALSE
spring.datasource.driverClassName=org.h2.Driver
spring.datasource.username=sa
spring.datasource.password=

# JPA/Hibernate Configuration
spring.jpa.database-platform=org.hibernate.dialect.H2Dialect
spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=create-drop
spring.jpa.show-sql=true
spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.format_sql=true

# H2 Console (for development)
spring.h2.console.enabled=true
spring.h2.console.path=/h2-console

# External API Configuration
external.api.base-url=https://api.example.com

# Logging
logging.level.com.example.userservice=DEBUG
logging.level.org.springframework.security=DEBUG
```

#### B. Test Application Properties (/workspace/src/test/resources/application-test.properties)

```properties
# Test Configuration
spring.application.name=userservice-test

# H2 In-Memory Database for tests
spring.datasource.url=jdbc:h2:mem:testdb;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1;DB_CLOSE_ON_EXIT=FALSE
spring.datasource.driverClassName=org.h2.Driver
spring.datasource.username=sa
spring.datasource.password=

# JPA Configuration for tests
spring.jpa.database-platform=org.hibernate.dialect.H2Dialect
spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=create-drop
spring.jpa.show-sql=false

# Disable H2 console in tests
spring.h2.console.enabled=false

# External API mock URL
external.api.base-url=http://localhost:8089

# Reduce logging noise in tests
logging.level.com.example.userservice=WARN
logging.level.org.springframework.security=WARN
```

### 5. TEST FILES

**Test File Location:** /workspace/src/test/java/com/example/userservice/UserServiceApplicationTests.java

**Test Cases:**
1. `contextLoads()` - Verifies Spring context loads successfully
2. `testCreateUser()` - Tests user creation with valid request
3. `testGetUserById()` - Tests user retrieval by ID
4. `testUpdateUser()` - Tests user update functionality
5. `testDeactivateUser()` - Tests user deactivation
6. `testDuplicateUsername()` - Tests duplicate username rejection

**Framework:** JUnit 5 with Spring Boot Test annotations
**Profile:** Uses `@ActiveProfiles("test")` to load test configuration

### 6. PROJECT ARCHITECTURE SUMMARY

**Project Type:** Spring Boot 2.7.18 Microservice (Legacy)

**Key Components:**

- **Model Layer:** User entity with Role enum
- **Repository Layer:** Spring Data JPA with custom query methods
- **Service Layer:** Business logic for user management and external API interactions
- **Controller Layer:** REST API endpoints with role-based authorization
- **Configuration:** Spring Security with method-level security, custom UserDetailsService
- **Exception Handling:** Global exception handler for standardized error responses
- **Security:** WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter (deprecated), BCrypt password encoding, CSRF disabled

**API Endpoints:**
- `GET /api/users` - List all users (ADMIN/MODERATOR)
- `GET /api/users/{id}` - Get user by ID (ADMIN/MODERATOR or owner)
- `GET /api/users/username/{username}` - Get user by username (ADMIN/MODERATOR)
- `POST /api/users` - Create new user (Public)
- `PUT /api/users/{id}` - Update user (ADMIN or owner)
- `DELETE /api/users/{id}` - Delete user (ADMIN)
- `PATCH /api/users/{id}/deactivate` - Deactivate user (ADMIN/MODERATOR)
- `GET /api/users/active` - List active users (ADMIN/MODERATOR)
- `GET /api/users/role/{role}` - List users by role (ADMIN)
- `GET /api/users/search` - Search users by query (ADMIN/MODERATOR)

**External Integrations:**
- Email verification service
- Notification service
- User profile enrichment service
- GDPR data deletion service

All files have been thoroughly examined and documented above.
